release_gates.requirement: The exact DNSMOS P.835 ONNX weights sig.onnx (SHA-256 d2fbdb293bc2366dfbae2b7477c490f981d24a8b4405efd3c11787569c6549d7) and bak_ovr.onnx (SHA-256 5f335c90994618150192a656a474bcf8a9cbcedbc47965494ba8da79605d1308), with the weights' own license terms, redistribution terms and written approval to execute; the repository license covers code only.

The exact NISQA checkpoint runs/NISQA/model_best.pt with an immutable revision, byte count, SHA-256 digest, model card and training-data statement, plus the pinned DNSMOS-C feature-extraction source revision and its code and weight terms.

The exact P.835 scorer revision (observed historical path data/envs/deepfilternet3/lib/python3.10/site-packages/df/scripts/dnsmos.py, SHA-256 abcfd3ee61b37a45728b2c7faaed8ced710e11e01d0a58daf4377363bc719fbb) plus a pinned and approved onnxruntime/numpy environment, and a pinned DNSMOS-C/NISQA runtime; an incidental environment is not a qualification.

A rights-cleared cohort for each protocol, with exact item identity, alignment and permissions. EARS is CC BY-NC 4.0 non-commercial research media and the Krisp 265-output set is CC BY-NC 4.0; neither grants redistribution of audio, outputs or derived score bundles beyond its documented research scope.

Numerical parity against the official implementations for the P.835 9.01 s window / 1 s hop replay, the DNSMOS-C 1 s minimum, 10 s repeat, 10 s window / 5 s hop and end-aligned tail, and the equal-weight three-scenario aggregation.

One representative valid item and one invalid/missing item validated end to end through the reported bundle, with predicted scores retained as predictions and never relabelled as human MOS, clean-reference accuracy or intelligibility.

Authorized listening or subjective MOS assessment kept separate from predicted scores, plus target-device timing, memory and availability measurement for the exact runtime where a device claim is made.
Opt-in developer/evidence adapter intake, license and public-surface review, independent exact-head approval and explicit release admission before any SDK exposure.
